answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the marble of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the island until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sparrow of the next round. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short.
